text:
zoe_sales: Quick ask  Customer (AtlasBank) wants an air-gapped POC delivered via USB and HSM-anchored offline activation. Need short checklist + pricing delta by EOD.

jasper_se: We can do USB + offline activation. Two options: 1) Redwood signs artifacts, customer re-signs with HSM (recommended), 2) final signing inside customer HSM (requires onsite ops/legal). Which do they prefer?

marta_eng: Technical constraints:
- Delta updates ok for app layer; model quant changes -> full image.
- Zero-telemetry build supported (`--no-telemetry`) but adds 3-5 biz days QA.
- Need SBOM + manifest in bundle.

li_sec: Security notes: we never hold customer private keys. We can provide signed SHA256 digests and a signed attestation PDF per release. If customer wants us to plug into their HSM for signing, legal must approve.

zoe_sales: They prefer we deliver Redwood-signed artifact plus an activation token they import to HSM. Also requested monthly attestation.

jasper_se: Pricing sketch: one-time packaging + USB prep $14k, SBOM & attestation $3k, optional monthly signed-delta retainer $2.5k/mo, emergency full-image hotfix $5k/event. Add clause for quant-driven full images.

ops-bot: job `usb-pack-atom` queued for `poc/AtlasBank`  est 2024-08-02T12:00:00Z.

marta_eng: Small sample manifest we'll include:
{"bundle_version":"2024.08.01","signed_by":"redwood-rel-4","delta_from":"2024.07.01","sbom":"sbom-2024.08.01.json","hsm_anchor":"sha256:<fingerprint>"}

zoe_sales: Thanks all  I'll send checklist + sketch pricing and ask for HSM fingerprint and allowed maintenance window.
